'''Farlonn's Padawan''' was a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Farlonn]] who lost her father to the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. She abandoned her training and headed to Tatooine to avenge her father, but succumbed to [[sand fever]]. She ran across [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Bleb-Blek]] while looking sick and spouting gibberish about revenge before she stole Jawa's map and ran into the desert. Bleb-Blek asked a Republic hero to help him find the map and the Padawan, but only her body and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] with her final message were discovered.<ref>{{TORcite|type=heroic|A Jawa's Concern|Tatooine}}</ref>
